title: 2025年6月四级真题 第3套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 Our society places a high value on physical beauty. Americans spend an average of over $722 each year on their appearance. One in ten Americans has tried to look like a star.

P2 There's nothing wrong with trying to look our best, but excessive focus on physical appearance misses the soulful aspects of what it means to be beautiful. Trying to look like the magazine pictures can take us on a long ride away from what beauty is really about.

P3 Many of us spend far too much time, energy, and money trying to polish an image of what we think will bring attention, love, and connection. In the process, we may fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning.

P4 It may sound trite(老生常谈的), but beauty is only skin deep; it's not what brings love toward us. Just read about the latest Hollywood starlets whose seeming love turns into resentment and bitter court battles.

P5 Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing. We may develop a habit of being so focused on maintaining a perfect appearance that we never cultivate the inner qualities necessary to sustain and deepen intimacy and connection. As I describe in my book, The Authentic Heart, it is the courage to be authentic that connects us in a deeper way.

P6 While our initial attraction may be based, in part, on physical chemistry, it is the meeting of our inner worlds that creates the lasting intimacy and spiritual connection for which we long. If we redirect our attention toward cultivating inner qualities, we might find a magnetic attraction that moves us from something superficial to something that connects us to our depths.

P7 The path toward cultivating inner beauty is really simple. But what is simple is not always easy. Not everyone will see us and appreciate us as we take the courageous risk to allow ourselves to be seen as we really are. But if they don't, it is their loss, not ours. Eventually we'll find those compatible souls who appreciate us as we are.

questions.q: What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph?
options: It sees lots of personal income wasted on beauty products.
It considers one's physical appearance very important.
It places a high value on the physical fitness of stars.
It expects every individual to look their very best.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph? 是 what...learn 型客观信息问答，且范围锁定首段，属于典型细节题。 46. What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph? A) It sees lots of personal income wasted on beauty products. B) It considers one's physical appearance very important. C) It places a high value on the physical fitness of stars. D) It expects every individual to look their very best.

【拆句】Q46 主干是 What do we learn about American society，from the first paragraph 是 状语限定信息来源；句子平铺直叙、无陷阱。

【定位】Our society places a high value on physical beauty. 我们的社会高度看重外貌。

【选项】A) 无中生有 It sees lots of personal income wasted on beauty products. 把 over $722 each year on their appearance 的客观花费篡改为 "被浪费"，原文从未做此评价。 B) ✓ 正确 places a high value on physical beauty ↔ considers one's physical appearance very important 预判 "美国社会把外貌看得很重要" 与 considers one's physical appearance very important 字面贴合，无需推断。 C) 偷换概念 places a high value on the physical fitness of stars 把 "看重外貌" 的主体悄悄换成 "明星的 physical fitness"；原文 One in ten Americans has tried to look like a star 只说有人想模仿明星，未谈明星本身的体魄。 D) 过度推断 It expects every individual to look their very best. 把 Our society places a high value on physical beauty 升级为 "要求每一个人都做到最好"，强度与范围都被拔高。 当人们努力让自己看起来更好时会发生什么? A) 他们必须为怨恨和激烈的法庭斗争做好准备。 B) 他们能够更好地获得关注、爱和人际联系。 C) 他们可能会忽视培养更重要的内在品质。 D) 他们觉得自己大量宝贵的时间、精力和资源被浪费了。

questions.q: What happens when people strive to look better?
options: They have to get prepared for resentment and bitter court battles.
They are better able to gain attention, love, and personal connection.
They may neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more.
They feel much of their precious time, energy and resources is wasted.
questions.explain:
【判型】What happens when people strive to look better? 询问某动作引发的客观后果，是典型 的因果型细节题。

【拆句】Q47 主干 What happens 后接 when 引导的时间状语从句，提示发生条件；结构简单无 陷阱。 47. What happens when people strive to look better? A) They have to get prepared for resentment and bitter court battles. B) They are better able to gain attention, love, and personal connection. C) They may neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more. D) They feel much of their precious time, energy and resources is wasted.

【定位】Many of us spend far too much time, energy, and money trying to polish an image of what we think will bring attention, love, and connection. In the process, we may fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning. 我们当中许多人花了过多的时间、精力和金钱去打磨一个我们以为会带来关注、爱与连结的 形象。在这个过程中，我们可能会忽略对自己的关照，错过本可带来更深亲密、满足与意义 的方式。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 They have to get prepared for resentment and bitter court battles. 把第 4 段说明 影星案例的 resentment and bitter court battles 强行移植到 Q47 的情境中，但原文 从未把这描述为追求外表的 "必然准备"。 B) 与原文相反 They are better able to gain attention, love, and personal connection. 把原文 what we think will bring attention, love, and connection 中 "我们以为会带来" 的主 观期待包装成客观事实，方向恰好与作者批评意图相反。 C) ✓ 正确 fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning ↔neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more 预判 "疏于关照内在更要紧的部分" 几乎逐字对应 neglect to cultivate the inner qualities that matter more。 D) 偷换概念 They feel much of their precious time, energy and resources is wasted. 把作者对 time, energy, and money 的客观描述换成 "他们自己觉得被浪费"，主体变成 they feel；原文未提及当事人有此自觉。 作者对外在美有何看法? A) 它可能是遗传的或培养的。 B) 它可能导致坏习惯也可能导致好习惯。 C) 它可能创造联系也可能造成孤立。 D) 它可能带来的伤害和好处一样多。

questions.q: What does the author say about outer beauty?
options: It may be inherited or cultivated.
It may lead to bad as well as good habits.
It may create connection or isolation.
It may do as much harm as good.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about outer beauty? 询问作者就某概念的明确陈述，归入细 节题。

【拆句】Q48 主干 What does the author say，about outer beauty 是介词短语状语；无难句 结构。 48. What does the author say about outer beauty? A) It may be inherited or cultivated. B) It may lead to bad as well as good habits. C) It may create connection or isolation. D) It may do as much harm as good.

【定位】Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing. 外在美既可能是祝福，也同样可能是诅咒。

【选项】A) 无中生有 It may be inherited or cultivated. 谈外貌的来源（遗传/后天培养），原文从未讨论外 貌的获得方式。 B) 偷换概念 It may lead to bad as well as good habits. 把 Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing. 改成 "导致好坏习惯"，对象层面从 "对人生整体的祸福" 缩到 "习 惯"。原文确实提到 develop a habit，但说的是 "只关注外表的习惯"，并非 "好习惯/坏 习惯" 的对照。 C) 与原文相反 It may create connection or isolation. 称外貌可能创造 connection；但 P5 P6 都 说 connection 来自 inner qualities / meeting of inner worlds，外貌不直接创 造 connection。 D) ✓ 正确 as much of a curse as a blessing ↔do as much harm as good 预判 "坏处与好处一样多" 直接命中 do as much harm as good，无需推断。 是什么带来精神上的联系? A) 思想的交汇。 B) 一见钟情的吸引。 C) 身体上的化学反应。 D) 频繁的互动。

Attraction at first sight.

questions.explain:
【判型】What brings about spiritual connection? 询问导致某结果的原因，对应原文中一处明确 的因→果叙述。

【拆句】Q49 主干 What brings about spiritual connection，brings about=cause/lead to，是 一个三个单词的简单疑问句。

【定位】While our initial attraction may be based, in part, on physical chemistry, it is the meeting of our inner worlds that creates the lasting intimacy and spiritual connection for which we long. 虽然最初的吸引可能在一定程度上源于身体的化学反应，但真正创造我们所渴求的长久亲密 与精神连结的，是内在世界的相遇。 49. What brings about spiritual connection? A) Meeting of minds. B) Attraction at first sight. C) Physical chemistry. D) Frequent interaction.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 the meeting of our inner worlds ↔Meeting of minds. 预判 "内在世界相遇" 几乎逐字对应 Meeting of minds.。 B) 与原文相反 Attraction at first sight. 对应 our initial attraction，但原文明确说这只是 "in part" 的 初始吸引，并非 spiritual connection 的来源。 C) 与原文相反 Physical chemistry. 直接抓取 physical chemistry 这一原词，但原文用 While 让步结 构说明它只贡献 initial attraction，不是 spiritual connection 的来源。 D) 无中生有 Frequent interaction. 谈交往频率，原文从未提及 spiritual connection 来自频繁 互动。 当我们走上培养内在美的道路时会发生什么? A) 我们可能会找到通往他人灵魂的路径。 B) 我们可能会更被周围的人欣赏。 C) 我们会遇到那些因我们本来的样子而珍视我们的人。 D) 我们会被劝阻不要展现真实的自己。

questions.q: What happens when we take the path toward cultivating inner beauty?
options: We may find a route toward other people's souls.
We may be appreciated more by people around us.
We will meet people who value us for who we are.
We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves.
questions.explain:
【判型】What happens when we take the path toward cultivating inner beauty? 仍是 what happens when 的因果型问法，问的是文章对此动作所述的结果。

【拆句】Q50 主干 What happens，when 从句中 take the path toward cultivating inner beauty 用了介词短语作 path 的修饰，toward 后接动名词 cultivating，提示这是个比喻：把培养 内在美比作走一条路。

【定位】Eventually we'll find those compatible souls who appreciate us as we are. 最终我们会遇到那些欣赏真实的我们的契合灵魂。 50. What happens when we take the path toward cultivating inner beauty? A) We may find a route toward other people's souls. B) We may be appreciated more by people around us. C) We will meet people who value us for who we are. D) We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 We may find a route toward other people's souls. 让 "我们走向别人的灵魂"；原文 P7 描述的是别人走向真实的我们，方向与重点都不一致。 B) 以偏概全 We may be appreciated more by people around us. 把 "被那些契合的人欣赏" 扩大 为 "被周围所有人更多地欣赏"；原文紧前一句明说 Not everyone will see us and appreciate us，恰好否定 "被周围人普遍更欣赏"。 C) ✓ 正确 Eventually we'll find those compatible souls who appreciate us as we are. ↔ We will meet people who value us for who we are. 预判 "最终遇到欣赏真实自我的人" 与 We will meet people who value us for who we are. 几乎逐字对应。 D) 与原文相反 We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves. 称我们会被打消展露真我的 念头；但原文 if they don't, it is their loss, not ours 是鼓励继续展露自我，与选项方向 相反。
